tools.name: open_now
tools.description: Places in Albuquerque, NM open right now (local time), from posted hours. Filter by kind (bar, coffee, restaurant, brewery...), neighborhood, or a word like patio, kids, late, live music.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Dated events in Albuquerque (shows, markets, comedy, classes) from each venue's own announcement. Defaults to today through 7 days out. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: weekly_nights
tools.description: Recurring weekly nights in Albuquerque: trivia, karaoke, bingo, live music, comedy, open mic. Filter by category or day (Monday..Sunday).

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search Albuquerque places (restaurants, bars, breweries, coffee, venues, shops) by words, kind or neighborhood.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: One Albuquerque place by its slug or name: hours, address, what it is, open now, upcoming events, weekly nights, guides it appears in.

tools.name: guides
tools.description: Today in ABQ's niche guides (green chile stew, posole, hot chocolate, late-night bars, just opened...). With a slug or words, returns that guide's picks and why.
